title: Everyday Phrases — A First Driving Lesson
title_quote: Do you have a spare key?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚗 實用「駕校初課」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A First Driving Lesson
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「駕校初課」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是教練：第一次上路：上車先調座椅和後照鏡、繫安全帶，教練示範三個踏板，起步、直線、打燈轉彎，路口熄火一次，練路邊停車與倒車，回場後教練總結、交代作業並約下次上課。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'A First Driving Lesson' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A first driving lesson: adjusting the seat and mirrors, learning the three pedals, stalling once at a junction, practising parallel parking, and booking the next lesson. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a spare key?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is in the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get in the car now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ɪn ðə kɑr naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, open the door gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the driver seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sit down and relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I do first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the seat back first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the seat lever?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is under your left leg.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I move the seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the lever and slide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way should the seat move?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forward, so your knees bend.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the seat too far back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, move it a little closer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the seat belt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is beside your right shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I fasten the seat belt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fasten it before driving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this belt feel too tight?
dialogue.zh: 這條安全帶會不會太緊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it looks fine to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the belt across my chest?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə bɛlt əˈkrɔs maɪ ʧɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 安全帶為什麼斜過我的胸口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps you safe in crashes.
dialogue.zh: 那樣能在撞擊時保護你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the mirrors easy to reach?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they turn quite easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This mirror looks a bit low.
dialogue.zh: 這面後照鏡看起來有點低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then turn the small knob up.
dialogue.zh: 那就把那個小旋鈕往上轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can you see in it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see the road behind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much of the road shows?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly all of the back window.
dialogue.zh: 幾乎整個後車窗都看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I adjust the side mirror?
dialogue.zh: 我可以調整側邊後照鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, use the small button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you always check both mirrors?
dialogue.zh: 你每次都看兩邊後照鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, before I start the engine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wheel too high for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə wil tu haɪ fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 方向盤對我會不會太高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lower the wheel a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are these three pedals for?
dialogue.zh: 這三個踏板是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They control the clutch, brake, gas.
dialogue.zh: 它們控制離合器、煞車和油門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pedal is the brake?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle one is the brake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press the brake with which foot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always use your right foot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do I press the clutch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before you change any gear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the clutch feel so soft?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə klʌʧ fil soʊ sɔft?/
dialogue.zh: 離合器為什麼踩起來這麼軟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Getting used to it takes time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the seat and mirrors first?
dialogue.zh: 要先調座椅和後照鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pull the belt across.
dialogue.zh: 然後把安全帶拉過來扣上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clutch is the left pedal.
dialogue.zh: 離合器是最左邊的踏板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and the middle is brake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels strange with three pedals.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will learn them quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the gas pedal go down far?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ɡæs ˈpɛdəl ɡoʊ daʊn fɑr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a little at first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, this feels more natural now.
dialogue.zh: 很好，現在感覺自然多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep both hands on the wheel.
dialogue.zh: 兩隻手都放在方向盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move the seat a bit forward.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that feels better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you set the mirrors?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both are set.
dialogue.zh: 調好了，兩邊都設定好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the mirrors for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look clear from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lean the seat back slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, or even lower?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always wear your belt, okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will not forget it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the pedals with your feet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brake feels quite hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your heel on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes the pedals steadier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now hold the wheel gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hands feel a bit stiff.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you comfortable in that seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but my legs ache.
dialogue.zh: 舒服，不過我的腿有點痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Raise the wheel a little higher.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, I can see clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the clutch with your left foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə klʌʧ wɪð jʊr lɛft fʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes down very easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest your right foot on nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So only one foot works?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kick the clutch in slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, like this, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never press the gas and brake.
dialogue.zh: 絕對不要同時踩油門和煞車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will remember that rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why must I sit up straight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You see the road much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my seat belt sit right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it sits across your chest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put both hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the wheel at nine and three.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə wil æt naɪn ænd θri/
dialogue.zh: 握在九點和三點鐘的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the gas pedal again.
dialogue.zh: 再指一次油門踏板給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the right one there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people press it with both feet?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl prɛs ɪt wɪð boʊθ fit?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that is quite dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I think I understand now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then start the engine soon.
dialogue.zh: 很好，那等一下發動引擎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which of these three pedals first?
dialogue.zh: 這三個踏板要先踩哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left one is the clutch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I start the car now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ stɑrt ðə kɑr naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要怎麼發動車子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the clutch pedal first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is first gear located?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First gear is on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I hold the clutch down?
dialogue.zh: 我要一直踩著離合器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your foot pressed down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about my right foot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest it on the gas pedal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the engine running smoothly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sounds very smooth now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I release the clutch slowly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, very slowly at first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car is starting to move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your eyes on the road.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast should I drive here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just drive slowly for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I going straight enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are driving straight and steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to check the mirrors?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu tʃɛk ðə ˈmɪrərz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check them every few seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The road looks clear ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep going at this speed.
dialogue.zh: 那就保持這個速度前進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands feel a little tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax your grip on the wheel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which lane should I stay in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay in the right lane.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a car behind us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just keep a steady speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I speed up a little?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press the gas gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the car is going faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay calm and hold it steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that noise outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is just the road surface.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I look at the speedometer?
dialogue.zh: 我可以看一下時速表嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glance at it very quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are driving quite well today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are doing a good job.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want me to slow down?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt mi tu sloʊ daʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ease off the gas a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I slow the car down?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ sloʊ ðə kɑr daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼讓車子慢下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the brake pedal gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car slows down smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep this slow speed now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the main road now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are on the main road.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are many cars around us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the car in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am getting used to this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the right feeling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn left at the corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɜrn lɛft æt ðə ˈkɔrnər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, signal before you turn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the turn signal lever?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is behind the steering wheel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I push the lever up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it up for a right turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt ʌp fɔr ə raɪt tɜrn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blinker is making a ticking sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈblɪŋkər ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə ˈtɪkɪŋ saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 我的方向燈一直發出滴答聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the signal works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I start the signal?
dialogue.zh: 我該什麼時候打方向燈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it on before the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a car coming from behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə kɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm bɪˈhaɪnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for it to pass first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I turn now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the road is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My turn was a bit wide.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time turn a little earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light ahead is turning red.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop before the white line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly should I stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right at the stop line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My engine just stopped suddenly.
dialogue.zh: 我的引擎剛剛突然熄火了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You released the clutch too fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did I do wrong?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your left foot came up quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it bad to stall the engine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt bæd tu stɔl ði ˈɛndʒən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it happens to everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I start the car again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the clutch and restart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cars behind us are waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay calm and take your time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am a little nervous now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slowly and try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I release the clutch better?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ rɪˈlis ðə klʌtʃ ˈbɛtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼把離合器放得更好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift your foot very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the car is moving again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change to second gear now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me how to change gear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the clutch and move it.
dialogue.zh: 踩離合器然後撥排檔桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second gear feels much smoother.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are learning very quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another corner is coming up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signal early and check mirrors.
dialogue.zh: 早點打方向燈，看一下後照鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way does this road turn?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns left after the bridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a bicycle on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈbaɪsɪkəl ɑn ðə lɛft/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down and give it room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I finish the turn slowly?
dialogue.zh: 我可以慢慢把彎轉完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time with it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for being patient.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did well at the intersection.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, park along the curb here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will turn the signal on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which car should I park behind?
dialogue.zh: 我該停在哪一輛車後面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind the white car, not closer.
dialogue.zh: 停在白色那輛後面，別再靠近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the mirror showing the back tire?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈmɪrər ˈʃoʊɪŋ ðə bæk ˈtaɪər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, but you must adjust it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bʌt ju mʌst əˈdʒʌst ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far are we from the curb?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɑr wi frʌm ðə kɜrb?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one hand from the curb.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use the reverse gear now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ juz ðə rɪˈvɜrs gɪr naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press the clutch fully first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I look over my shoulder?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, always check the blind spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you see the car behind us?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju si ðə kɑr bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The truck is waiting for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back the car slowly and gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am backing very slowly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch your left mirror while reversing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am watching it all the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ɪt ɔl ðə taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop the car right here please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I stopped the car already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should the car end up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beside the tree, next to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, we are fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I feel less nervous.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did I do wrong just now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd aɪ du rɔŋ dʒʌst naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are still far from the curb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr stɪl fɑr frʌm ðə kɜrb/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I fix it and start again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ fɪks ɪt ænd stɑrt əˈgɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pull forward and try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is somebody behind me right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the road behind is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we allowed to park here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a sign saying no.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you check the mirrors?
dialogue.zh: 你為什麼一直看後照鏡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They tell me where the car is.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ tɛl mi wɛr ðə kɑr ɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I keep the car straight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ kip ðə kɑr streɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼讓車保持直線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the wheel lightly and look back.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə wil ˈlaɪtli ænd lʊk bæk/
dialogue.zh: 方向盤輕握，眼睛往後看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I open the door and look?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr ænd lʊk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just use the side mirror.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am going to try again.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ æm ˈgoʊɪŋ tu traɪ əˈgɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, take it nice and slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I turn the wheel?
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候該轉方向盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it when the mirror shows curb.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt wɛn ðə ˈmɪrər ʃoʊz kɜrb/
dialogue.zh: 後照鏡看到路邊時就轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this close enough to the curb?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs kloʊs ɪˈnʌf tu ðə kɜrb?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, move a little closer please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many turns should I make?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One full turn to the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to check mirror again?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu tʃɛk ˈmɪrər əˈgɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要再看一次後照鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and before you move forward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the car sits by the curb.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə kɑr sɪts baɪ ðə kɜrb/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, you did that one well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now listen to me very carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am listening to you, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the cars in the other mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə kɑrz ɪn ði ˈʌðər ˈmɪrər/
dialogue.zh: 看另一邊後照鏡裡的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small car is passing us.
dialogue.zh: 有一輛小車正經過我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your foot off the clutch slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr fʊt ɔf ðə klʌtʃ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 腳慢慢從離合器上移開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My foot is off the pedal now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fʊt ɪz ɔf ðə ˈpɛdəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的腳已經離開踏板了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the car is moving backwards now.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ðə kɑr ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ ˈbækwərdz naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels slower than I thought.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stop and look again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以停下來再看一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop and look, that is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back of the car is close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk əv ðə kɑr ɪz kloʊs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much space is left behind?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is still a lot of space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz stɪl ə lɑt əv speɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will keep reversing slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, a bicycle is coming behind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ə ˈbaɪsɪkəl ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，後面有腳踏車過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I stopped the car right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn your head and look back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bicycle has already passed us.
dialogue.zh: 那輛腳踏車已經過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, keep going back a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am going back very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my hand position on wheel okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ hænd pəˈzɪʃən ɑn wil oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我握方向盤的手勢對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move your left hand down a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv jɔr lɛft hænd daʊn ə bɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you always look at the mirror?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔlweɪz lʊk æt ðə ˈmɪrər?/
dialogue.zh: 你都一直看著後照鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I look at it every few seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʊk æt ɪt ˈɛvri fju ˈsɛkəndz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the wheel a little left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, or even more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the wheels straight right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look a little to the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk ə ˈlɪtəl tu ðə lɛft/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the back wheel now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is near the curb already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your eyes on that mirror.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eyes are on it, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the car is almost straight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I stop the car here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, stop the car and rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My legs feel a little tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you press the brake?
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛在哪裡踩了煞車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pressed it when the bicycle came.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛst ɪt wɛn ðə ˈbaɪsɪkəl keɪm/
dialogue.zh: 腳踏車過來的時候我踩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was my passenger brake, right?
dialogue.zh: 那是我踩的副煞車，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can feel it under your foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn fil ɪt ˈʌndər jɔr fʊt/
dialogue.zh: 你的腳下可以感覺得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is my job on this side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb ɑn ðɪs saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the car can stop safely.
dialogue.zh: 這樣車子才能安全停下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, let us drive back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will signal and move out.
dialogue.zh: 我打方向燈然後開出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice work today with the parking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I want more practice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop beside the curb and reverse slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp bɪˈsaɪd ðə kɜrb ænd rɪˈvɜrs ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 停在路邊，然後慢慢倒車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will check the mirror first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which mirror shows the curb?
dialogue.zh: 哪一面後照鏡看得到路邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left one shows it clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me park near the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down and check the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which spot is ours today?
dialogue.zh: 今天哪個車位是我們的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one beside the blue car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the wheel a little more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am turning it very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop right here and hold still.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car is almost in line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now put the gear in park.
dialogue.zh: 現在把排檔打到停車檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is already in park now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the hand brake up please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the car will not move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switch off the engine and lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I turned off the engine first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this how we end the lesson?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs haʊ wi ɛnd ðə ˈlɛsən?/
dialogue.zh: 我們下課都這樣結束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we always park here first.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們每次都先停在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your bag from the back seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr bæɡ frʌm ðə bæk sit/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check under the seat too.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ˈʌndər ðə sit tu/
dialogue.zh: 讓我也檢查一下座位底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many minutes did we drive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half an hour on the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt hæf ən ˈaʊər ɑn ðə roʊd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I do anything really wrong?
dialogue.zh: 我有做什麼真的很糟的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your steering is much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I practice this week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practice the clutch and the brake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write the homework down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it in your notebook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is my next lesson, Coach?
dialogue.zh: 教練，我下次上課是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at the schedule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we meet on Saturday morning?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以星期六早上見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday morning is fine with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I come here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come at nine and bring your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm æt naɪn ænd brɪŋ jʊr kɑrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my learner permit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, always carry it with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I pay for today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please pay at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I return this clipboard?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to the man inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a photo allowed here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but do not post it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs feel a bit tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal for the first day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl fɔr ðə fɜrst deɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the parking part okay today?
dialogue.zh: 今天的停車部分還可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You parked straight on the first try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pɑrkt streɪt ɑn ðə fɜrst traɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for being patient with me.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你對我這麼有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You listened well the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you on Saturday at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe and study the notes.
dialogue.zh: 開車小心，把筆記讀一讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will practice before the next class.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈpræktɪs bɪˈfɔr ðə nɛkst klæs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that will help you a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt wɪl hɛlp ju ə lɑt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Review the three pedals before Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 星期六前複習三個踏板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will read my notes tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the wheel with both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both hands, I will remember that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not rush when the light turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt rʌʃ wɛn ðə laɪt tɜrnz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wait for green.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your mirror check was very good.
dialogue.zh: 你的後照鏡檢查做得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I practiced it a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju aɪ ˈpræktɪst ɪt ə lɑt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try to brake a bit earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will brake earlier next time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did the engine stop there?
dialogue.zh: 引擎為什麼在那裡停了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clutch came up too fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I look when turning?
dialogue.zh: 轉彎的時候我該看哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look where you want to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who taught you to drive, Coach?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My father taught me many years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɑðər tɔt mi ˈmɛni jɪrz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我爸爸很多年前教我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you been teaching?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have taught for ten years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pedal do I press first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clutch comes before the gas.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we practice parking again?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再練一次停車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will do it next lesson.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my speed too slow on hills?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ spid tu sloʊ ɑn hɪlz?/
dialogue.zh: 我在上坡時車速太慢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, slow is safe for a beginner.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sloʊ ɪz seɪf fɔr ə bɪˈɡɪnər/
dialogue.zh: 不會，對新手來說慢才安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is my biggest problem now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在最大的問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look down at the gear stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk daʊn æt ðə ɡɪr stɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I book the car for Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ bʊk ðə kɑr fɔr ˈsætərˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我該預約星期六的車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the desk will book it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have my phone number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is written there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you call me if it changes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju kɔl mi ɪf ɪt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 如果有變動你會打給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call you on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try the main road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wi kæn traɪ ðə meɪn roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 也許我們可以試試主要道路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can try when you are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn traɪ wɛn ju ɑr ˈrɛdi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the lessons always this long?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most lessons last about an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I felt nervous at the first corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɛlt ˈnɜrvəs æt ðə fɜrst ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 我在第一個轉角很緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone feels nervous the first time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the notes home and read them.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə noʊts hoʊm ænd rid ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will read them after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember to bring your permit again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is always in my wallet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands were shaking a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will stop after some practice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the clear lesson.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你這麼清楚的教學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did well for a first try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd wɛl fɔr ə fɜrst traɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's meet at the same spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same spot, same time on Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 同一個地方，星期六同樣時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go home and rest your legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will sleep early tonight.

issues.note: A 問『Can you see the car behind us?』、B 答『The truck is waiting for us.』——car 突兀變 truck，指稱不一致（非致命，可讀成後方另有一輛卡車）。
『Turn it when the mirror shows curb.』（視圖行 242）缺冠詞，宜作 the curb；同類小疵另有行 81『Rest your right foot on nothing.』略生硬、行 289『passenger brake』美式口語多說 instructor brake。
『Getting used to it takes time.』（視圖行 48）結構已補全，但對 why 未正面作答，屬安撫式回應，可接受。
118-119『Do I need to check the mirrors? / Check them every few seconds.』與 272-273『Do you always look at the mirror? / I look at it every few seconds.』高度近似；Should I／Do I／Where is 開頭偏多，屬循環練習體裁所致。
『Is this how we end the lesson? / Yes, we always park here first.』此處已是收尾停車，first 一詞略鬆，語意稍浮。
